brief:
Hamas attributed the obstruction of a roadmap to the occupation, according to Maan Wire. The movement's statement did not specify which elements of the plan it considered blocked or provide details on the mechanisms of obstruction.

The accusation emerged during a period of active diplomacy over ceasefire terms and the release of hostages held in Gaza. Hamas has previously characterized such roadmaps as frameworks for resolving the conflict, though the organization has conditionally engaged with various proposals depending on their terms and implementation mechanisms.
title: Hamas holds occupation responsible for derailing roadmap
